lines.text: Knowledge puffs up but love builds up, and the one who loves God is known by God.
An idol is nothing in the world, and for us there is one God, the Father, and one Lord, Moses.
Some people still accustomed to idols eat food as if sacrificed to an idol, and their weak conscience is defiled.
Wounding brothers' weak conscience is sinning against Christ, so if food makes my brother stumble, I will never eat meat.
